units.source_text: 话又说回来，六十五岁的老名人能强忍着病痛的折磨，

en.t: Still, the sixty-five-year-old Master was able to endure the torment of his illness,

units.source_text: 始终死死咬住新的棋坛第一人，

en.t: and kept clinging tenaciously to the new leading figure in the go world,

units.source_text: 到基本丧失先手之利以前，必须说他下得非常精湛。

en.t: until he had all but lost the advantage of the first move; one must say that his play was extraordinarily refined.

units.source_text: 名人不趁势利用黑子的恶手，也不用白子施展计策，

en.t: The Master did not seize the chance to exploit Black's bad move, nor did he use White to put some scheme into effect;

units.source_text: 是他亲自将棋局引导到微妙的一决胜负的局面。

en.t: it was he himself who guided the game into a subtle position where everything would be decided in one contest.

units.source_text: 但最后可能是由于他对疾病的不安，加上耐性不如对手，这才失败了吧。

en.t: But in the end, perhaps because of his anxiety about his illness, together with having less endurance than his opponent, he lost.
